newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.120pts to 102.960.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.120pts to 102.960.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.120 points in Monday's trading to 102.960, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.272 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.111 points to 99.390 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.212 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 4.893 points to 1,047.740.
